newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC says to wipe out losses at electronics unit.
newsitem.headline: NEC says to wipe out losses at electronics unit.

text.p: NEC Corp said on Thursday that an accumulated deficit at its consumer electronics unit NEC Home Electronics will be wiped out by next March as a result of restructuring measures announced earlier in the day.
NEC had expected its unit's accumulated deficit would have reached 130 billion yen by the end of March if restructuring measures had not been implemented.
As part of the restructuring, NEC Home Electronics' capitalisation will be reduced to 1.5 billion yen next year from the current 131.5 billion yen.
"We are still facing an uphill battle but we think we have just passed an important hurdle," senior vice president Shigeru Matsumoto told a news conference.

He said NEC expects parent operating profits of 100 billion yen for the current business year to the end of March 1997, up five percent from the previous year. The firm's group operating profit is expected at 180 billion yen, down 27 percent, he said.
